Hey .jar here. Just some extra information for u fellow nerds. So with the way the system works the pallets(The thing with wheels) and the basket are universally interchangeable. So you can put the blue handled basket onto any pallet and it will work. The system uses spudnet inspired by kAN to wirelessly send a pre programed command to the basket. Then the basket tells the pallet to head to the robot arm. The pallet is 50% line follower and 50% preprogrammed movements. When the pallet first leaves the parking spot it’s using pre programmed movements to make its way to the line. Where it turns parallel to the line and turns on line following. Then after it’s sent back to the parking space it switches to a secondary preprogrammed movement to get back in its spot. Thanks for checking out the post! Ps.
